DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 一周の案内をご覧ですね。お時間に合わせて歩く場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the circuit guide. Are you looking for somewhere to walk that fits your available time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が迎えに来るまで三十分あります。図の「一周二十分」なら、休憩しても余裕があると思ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えまで三十分あるので、一周二十分の目安なら休憩も含め余裕があると思ってよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have thirty minutes before my friend picks me up. If the map says ‘twenty minutes for one circuit,’ can I assume there's enough time even with a break?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether thirty minutes until pickup leaves enough time for a break if the circuit estimate is twenty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この時間は目安で、歩く速さや途中の休憩は人によって違います。一周しないで入口付近で過ごすこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That time is only a guide. Walking speed and breaks vary from person to person. You can also stay near the entrance without completing the circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十分で必ず戻れるわけではないのですね。今日はもう歩いて疲れているので、一周することを目標にしないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目安時間で必ず戻れるわけでなく既に歩いて疲れているため、一周を目標にしないと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I'm not guaranteed to return within twenty minutes. I've already walked and feel tired today, so I won't make completing the circuit my goal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide not to aim for a complete circuit because the estimate does not guarantee your return time and you are already tired from walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今のご希望なら、この入口沿いの花壇を見てから、すぐ横の休憩場所へ戻る道を図で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: For what you want now, we can check the map for a route along the flower beds by this entrance and back to the rest area right beside them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇の先へ回り込まず、入口側で見ます。休憩場所が混んでいたら、遠い広場の席を探すより、ここへ戻って案内を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口側の花壇だけ見て、近い休憩場所が混めば遠い広場で席を探さず案内所へ戻ってよいか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll view the flowers from the entrance side without going around beyond them. If the nearby rest area is crowded, may I return here for advice rather than look for a seat in the distant square?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether you can view only the entrance-side flower beds and return to the information desk if the nearby rest area is crowded, instead of searching the distant square for a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。遠くへ席を探しに行く必要はありません。ここで近くの状況をお尋ねください。お迎えの方とはどこで会う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You don't need to go far looking for a seat. Ask us here about nearby conditions. Where are you planning to meet the person picking you up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で会う約束だけです。入口がいくつもあるようなので、今いる案内所のそばと具体的に連絡しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人とは入口とだけ約束したため、複数の入口を混同しないよう案内所のそばと具体的に連絡したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We only agreed on the entrance. There seem to be several entrances, so I want to tell my friend specifically that I'll be near this information desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you only agreed to meet at the entrance and want to specify near the information desk so you don't confuse the multiple entrances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図の現在地表示を一緒に確認しましょう。待ち合わせ先へも、その表示が伝わるようにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the ‘you are here’ marker on this map together. Tell the person you're meeting in a way that conveys that marker too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地を写して友人に送り、案内所のそばで待つと伝えます。散歩を続けるより、花壇を少し見たら休んで迎えを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地を写して友人へ送り、花壇を少し見るだけにして案内所付近で休み迎えを待つと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll photograph our current location and send it to my friend, saying I'll wait near the information desk. Rather than continue walking, I'll look at the flowers briefly, then rest and wait for pickup.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide to send your friend a picture of your current location, look only briefly at the flowers, and rest near the information desk while waiting for pickup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻る位置が決まりましたね。この紙の図もどうぞ。時間や一周にこだわらず、お休みを取りながらお過ごしください。ご案内は以上です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've decided where to return. Please take this paper map too. Don't be bound by the time or completing a circuit; take breaks as you spend your time here. That's all the guidance for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の候補がいくつか出ていますね。行先は、どのようにお聞きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Several route options have appeared. How did you learn the name of your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家へ行くため、音声で聞いた駅名を入力しました。一番上の候補で乗換を調べてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音声で聞いた駅名を入力し、最初の検索候補で友人宅への乗換を調べてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to my friend's home and entered the station name I heard in an audio message. May I use the first search result to check transfers?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you entered a station name heard in an audio message and ask whether you can use the first result to check transfers to your friend's home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読みが同じでも別の駅の場合があります。友人の方から、漢字や路線名は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Stations can have the same pronunciation and still be different stations. Has your friend sent the kanji or the line name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 漢字はまだ聞いていません。候補の隣にある地図も見ずに選んだので、切符を買う前に友人へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字を知らず地図も見ずに候補を選んだと説明し、購入前に友人へ駅名を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked for the kanji yet. I chose the result without checking the map beside it, so I'll ask my friend before buying a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you chose the result without knowing the kanji or checking the map, and will ask your friend for the station name before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返事が来るまで購入はお待ちください。こちらの候補と見比べられるよう、駅名と路線名を伺うとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait to purchase until you receive a reply. Ask for the station and line names so we can compare them with these results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返信が来ました。この漢字と路線名です。さっき選んだ駅とは字が違いますから、これで調べ直していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の返信にある漢字と路線を示し、最初の候補とは別の駅として検索し直すよう頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The reply has arrived. Here are the kanji and line name. The characters differ from the station I selected earlier, so could you search again using these?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the kanji and line in your friend's reply and request a new search for this different station rather than the first result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表記を基に確認します。乗換の回数を減らすことと、駅からの歩行時間では、どちらを優先されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check based on this written name. Which matters more: fewer transfers or less walking from the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅には友人が迎えに来るので、徒歩の時間より乗換が少ない経路を希望します。ただ、迎えの時刻はまだ約束していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が駅へ迎えに来るため乗換の少なさを優先し、迎えの時刻は未定だと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend will meet me at the station, so I prefer fewer transfers over less walking. But we haven't agreed on a pickup time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, prioritize fewer transfers because your friend will meet you at the station, and explain that the pickup time is not yet set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その条件で候補を比較します。到着見込みをお伝えする際も、乗換や運行状況によって変わる点はご承知おきください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare options with those conditions. When we give an estimated arrival, please understand that transfers and service conditions can change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見込みが分かってから友人に迎えを相談します。購入前に、この漢字の駅が行先になっているか、もう一度一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着見込みが分かってから迎えを相談し、購入前に行先の漢字を一緒に照合したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I know the estimated arrival, I'll discuss pickup with my friend. Before buying, I'd like us to check once more that the destination is the station with these kanji.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will discuss pickup after learning the estimated arrival and want to compare the destination kanji together before purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行先の漢字と路線を、検索結果と購入画面で照合しましょう。確認が済むまで購入操作を進めず、この画面を開いたままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's compare the destination kanji and line in the search results and purchase screen. Don't proceed with the purchase until we've checked; please wait with this screen open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの画像について、証明書を取り直すかどうかのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking whether to obtain a new certificate because of the image you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ住所の証明を出すのですが、前に取った紙の写真があります。この画像でよければ、新しく申請しなくてもよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社への住所証明に以前の紙の写真を使えば新規申請を省けるか相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit proof of address to my company, and I have a photograph of a paper document I obtained before. I thought I might not need a new application if this image is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether using a photo of an older paper document as proof of address for your company would let you avoid a new application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画像にある住所は今のお住まいですか。また、会社から発行日について指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the address in the image where you live now? Did the company specify anything about the issue date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越す前の住所でした。案内に「最近のもの」とありますが、何か月以内なのかは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像が転居前の住所で、会社の「最近のもの」という条件の期間も不明だと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was my address before I moved. The instructions say ‘a recent one,’ but don't say within how many months.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the image shows your previous address and the period meant by your company's ‘recent’ requirement is also unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表現だけでは必要な発行日を決められません。オンラインでの提出と、紙の原本については、どのように書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording alone doesn't establish the required issue date. What does it say about online submission and the original paper document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は画像を送るとありますが、後で原本を出すかどうかは分かりません。写真を送れることと、原本が不要なことは別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の画像提出は指示されているが後の原本要否は不明で、画像提出と原本不要は別だと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says to send an image first, but I don't know whether I must submit the original later. Being able to send a photo and not needing the original are separate matters, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, confirm that an initial image submission is required but later need for the original is unknown, and that image submission does not mean the original is unnecessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。会社が求める書類名、記載する住所、発行日の条件と、原本の要否を確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please confirm the document name, the address it must show, the issue-date conditions, and whether the original is needed with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の担当者へ、今の住所が載ったどの書類が必要か、発行日と原本の扱いもまとめて尋ねます。返事前に申請書を出すのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在住所を示す書類名・発行日・原本の扱いを会社に尋ね、回答前の申請を保留する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the company contact which document showing my current address they need, together with the issue date and how the original is handled. I'll wait to submit an application until they reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will ask your company about the document name for your current address, its issue date and original, and hold off applying until the reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件が分かったら案内をお持ちください。こちらでは、その条件に合う申請ができるか、必要な確認や費用を含めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring the instructions once you know the conditions. We can explain whether an application meeting them is available here, including the necessary checks and fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信を持って改めて相談します。今日は古い住所の画像をそのまま送らず、会社には確認中だと連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の返信を持って再相談し、古い住所の画像は送らず確認中だと会社へ連絡すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return for advice with their reply. Today I won't simply send the old-address image; I'll tell the company I'm checking the requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will return with the company's reply, not send the old-address image, and tell the company you are checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご案内と返信をそろえてお持ちください。申請は保留として、今回はここまでのご相談を承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring both the instructions and reply. We'll leave the application on hold, and that concludes today's consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の食事に関する欄で、手が止まっていらっしゃいますね。どの言葉を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've stopped at the food-related section of the medical questionnaire. Which word would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「食後に痛むことがありますか」の食後は、毎回の食事の後という意味ですか。夕ご飯の後だけなので、答えを迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 「食後」が毎食後を意味するか尋ね、夕食後だけなので回答に迷うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does ‘after meals’ in ‘Do you sometimes have pain after meals?’ mean after every meal? It happens only after dinner, so I'm unsure how to answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether ‘after meals’ means after every meal and explain that you are unsure because it happens only after dinner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食後は食事をした後という意味で、毎回とは限りません。いつから、体のどの辺りに症状がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: ‘After meals’ means after eating, not necessarily every time. Since when have you had symptoms, and where in your body?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一昨日の夜から、夕ご飯の後にみぞおちの辺りが痛みます。朝ご飯や昼ご飯の後には、今のところありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一昨日の夜から夕食後にみぞおちが痛み、朝昼の食後には今のところないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since the night before last, I've had pain around the pit of my stomach after dinner. So far, it hasn't happened after breakfast or lunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that pain around the pit of your stomach has occurred after dinner since the night before last, but so far not after breakfast or lunch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いもお書きください。一度痛み始めると、どのくらい続くかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write that distinction too. Do you remember how long the pain lasts once it begins?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時計を見ていませんが、昨日は片付けが終わるころには治まっていました。正確な分数が分からないと書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日は片付けが終わるころに治まり、正確な分数は不明と記入してよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wasn't watching the clock, but yesterday it had settled by the time I finished clearing up. May I write that I don't know the exact number of minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask whether you may write that yesterday's pain settled by the end of clearing up and the exact duration in minutes is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる範囲と、不明な点を分けて伝えてください。今回の症状で飲んだ薬や、普段お使いの薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Distinguish what you know from what you don't. Have you taken medicine for these symptoms, or do you use any regular medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回の痛みでは薬を飲んでいません。普段の薬は名前を覚えていませんが、袋の写真を家族に送ってもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の痛みでは服薬せず、普段の薬名は不明だが家族から袋の写真を送ってもらえると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't taken medicine for this pain. I don't remember the names of my regular medicines, but my family can send me a photo of the medicine bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you took no medicine for this pain and don't know the regular medicine names, but can have your family send a photo of their bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真が届いたら診察で見せられるようにしてください。私からも伝えますが、診察の説明で特に不安なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the photo arrives, have it ready to show at the examination. I'll pass this on too, but is there anything in particular that worries you about the doctor's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病名を聞き取れないとき、もう一度ゆっくり説明してほしいです。薬の写真がまだ届かなければ、名前は不明だと医師に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 病名が聞き取れない際はゆっくり再説明を希望し、写真未着なら薬名不明と医師に伝えると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I can't catch the disease name, I'd like it explained again slowly. If the medicine photo hasn't arrived, I'll tell the doctor the names are unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, request another slow explanation if you cannot catch the disease name, and say you will tell the doctor the medicine names are unknown if the photo has not arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望を診察担当へ申し送ります。書けた問診票をお預かりしますので、症状の判断は診察で医師にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your request to the examination staff. I'll take the completed questionnaire; please consult the doctor during the examination about assessment of your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送金を求める連絡について、ご相談があると伺いました。何がきっかけで不審に思われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you want advice about a request to send money. What made you suspicious?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が番号を変えたという連絡を信じて、お金を振り込みました。その後、前から使っていた連絡先の友人に聞くと、頼んでいないと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の新番号を信じ送金した後、以前の連絡先の本人が依頼を否定したと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I believed a message saying my friend had changed numbers and transferred money. Afterward I asked my friend through their established contact, and they said they hadn't requested it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you transferred money believing a friend's new-number message, but the friend denied requesting it when contacted through their old contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、相手が近くに来ていたり、直接会う約束をしていたりしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the other person come near you now, or have you arranged to meet in person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会う約束はなく、近くに来るとも言われていません。ただ、新しい番号からは追加で振り込むよう連絡が続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会う約束や接近の連絡はないが、新番号から追加送金の要求が続くと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: We haven't arranged to meet, and they haven't said they're coming nearby. But the new number keeps sending requests for additional transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that there is no meeting arrangement or message about approaching you, but requests for more money keep coming from the new number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その連絡と、友人本人からの返事を両方残してください。振込の時刻や、手続きの控えは確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep both those messages and the reply from your actual friend. Can you check the transfer time and your transaction receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 振込の控えとメッセージの履歴があります。友人が否定した返事も消していないので、時刻が分かる形でお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込控え・要求の履歴・本人の否定の返事を、時刻が分かる状態で示すと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the transfer receipt and message history. I haven't deleted my friend's denial either, so I'll show them with their times visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will show the transfer receipt, request history, and your friend's denial with the times visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を基に詳しく伺います。振り込んだ銀行には、すでに連絡なさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask in detail using those records. Have you already contacted the bank you used to transfer the money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。警察へ相談すれば銀行にも自動的に伝わり、お金が戻ると思っていましたが、自分から銀行にも連絡が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行未連絡で、警察への相談が自動連絡や返金になると思っていたと伝え、別途銀行への連絡要否を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I thought consulting the police would automatically notify the bank and get the money back. Do I need to contact the bank myself too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you haven't contacted the bank and thought police consultation meant automatic notification and reimbursement, then ask whether separate bank contact is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 警察への相談だけで返金が決まるものではありません。銀行で対応できることもありますので、送金済みであることを銀行へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consulting the police alone doesn't determine a refund. The bank may be able to take action, so tell them the money has already been transferred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加では振り込まず、この相談を進めながら銀行にも送金後の対応を尋ねます。二つの連絡先の記録と控えを、こちらで確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加送金せず銀行にも送金後の対応を尋ね、両連絡先の記録と控えを警察に確認してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't transfer any more. While continuing this consultation, I'll also ask the bank what can be done after the transfer. I'd like you to check the records from both contacts and the receipt here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't send more money, will ask the bank about action after the transfer, and ask the police to check both contacts' records and the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、送金までの順序から伺います。お持ちの記録をこちらにご用意ください。返金の可否は、この場ではお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll start with the sequence leading to the transfer. Please have your records ready here. We can't promise here whether the money can be refunded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の前に、中身の欄を確認しています。「本」とありますが、ほかに入れた物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before shipment, we're checking the contents field. It says ‘books’; did you add anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は本だけでしたが、最後に古いタブレットも入れました。国内の家族へ送る箱で、まだ封はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内の家族向けの本の箱に最後に古い端末を加え、まだ封をしていないと申告する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first it was only books, but I added an old tablet at the end. The box is for my family within Japan, and I haven't sealed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, declare that you added an old device to a box of books for family within Japan at the end, and have not sealed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端末が入ると確認する条件が変わる場合があります。機種や、中の電池について分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Including a device may change the conditions we need to check. Do you have information about the model or its battery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 機種名は本体の裏で確認できそうですが、電池の種類は分かりません。本と一緒なら同じ扱いだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機種名は本体で確認できそうだが電池は不明で、本と同じ扱いと思っていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think I can check the model name on the back of the device, but I don't know the battery type. I thought it would be handled just like the books if packed with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the model may be identifiable on the device but the battery type is unknown, and you thought it would be handled like books.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身を詳しく確認してから、お受けできる方法を調べます。端末そのものに、故障など気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the contents in detail before looking into acceptable shipping methods. Does the device itself have any issues, such as a fault?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最近使っていないので、今の状態を確かめていません。ここで送れると決まってから、箱を閉じるつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最近使っておらず端末の現在の状態も未確認で、受付可能と分かってから封をするつもりだったと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't used it recently, so I haven't checked its current condition. I was planning to close the box after learning whether it can be sent here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you haven't used the device recently or checked its current condition, and planned to seal the box after acceptance was confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態や電池の情報が不明なままでは、こちらでも今すぐ受け付ける判断はできません。資料を確かめてから改めてご相談いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: With its condition and battery information unknown, we can't decide to accept it immediately either. Could you check the information and consult us again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いったん箱を持ち帰って、機種の資料を探します。内容欄を本だけのままにせず、端末も含めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を持ち帰り機種の資料を探し、内容欄を本だけにせず端末も含めて相談すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the box home for now and look for the model information. I won't leave the contents field as books only; I'll include the device in the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will take the box home, find model information, and consult about the device too rather than leaving the contents as books only.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 端末をどうするか決まった段階で、実際に送る内容に合わせてご相談ください。ご家族が急いで必要としているのは、本と端末の両方でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you decide what to do with the device, consult us based on what you will actually send. Does your family urgently need both the books and device?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 急ぎなのは本のほうです。端末は今回見送ることも家族と相談し、送る中身を決めてから料金と利用条件を確認しに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急ぎなのは本だと答え、端末を今回送らない選択も家族と相談し、内容決定後に料金と条件を再相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's the books that are urgent. I'll discuss with my family the option of leaving out the device this time, and return to check the price and conditions once the contents are decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, answer that the books are urgent, discuss with family the option of not sending the device this time, and return about charges and conditions after deciding the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は未発送として箱をお返しします。次回は実際の内容と確認できた資料をお持ちになり、封をする前にお声をおかけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll return the box as not shipped today. Next time, bring the actual contents and the information you've verified, and speak to us before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 授業料のお振込について、画面を見ながら確かめたい点がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check something on the screen about your tuition transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜手続きをしましたが、残高が減っていません。失敗したと思って、窓口でもう一度振り込もうか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜の授業料手続き後に残高が減らず、失敗と思い窓口で再送するか迷うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I completed the procedure last night, but my balance hasn't decreased. I thought it failed, and I'm unsure whether to transfer it again at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that your balance didn't decrease after last night's tuition procedure and you are considering another transfer at the counter because you think it failed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の履歴には、どのような状態が表示されていますか。実行日を選んだ覚えも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What status appears in the screen's history? Please also tell me whether you remember selecting an execution date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「予約」と出ています。日付は来週を選びましたが、予約したらすぐ残高が減ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴は予約で来週の日付を選んだが、予約直後に残高が減ると思っていたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says ‘scheduled.’ I selected a date next week, but thought the balance would decrease immediately when I scheduled it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the history says scheduled and you selected next week's date, but thought the balance would decrease as soon as it was scheduled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の表示だけで実行済みとは判断できません。個別の状態を確認しますので、認証に必要な手続きをご案内します。お急ぎの理由はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: A scheduled status alone doesn't mean it has been executed. We'll check the specific status and explain the identification procedure needed. Is there a reason you're in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 学校の締切が今週だと、今気づきました。来週の予約を残したまま今日も送ると、二回になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 学校の期限が今週だと気づき、来週の予約を残して今日送れば二重になるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've just realized the school's deadline is this week. If I send it today while leaving next week's scheduled transfer in place, won't that make two payments?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you realized the school's deadline is this week and ask whether paying today with next week's scheduled transfer still active would duplicate payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重複する可能性があるので、確認前に新しい振込を進めないでください。予約の変更や取消が可能かも、状態を確認してからのご案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There could be duplication, so don't proceed with a new transfer before we check. We can explain whether the scheduled transfer can be changed or canceled only after checking its status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず予約の状態と、日付変更か取消ができるかを調べてください。変更できない場合の対応も、手数料を含めて聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約状態と変更・取消の可否を先に調べ、できない場合の対応や費用も聞いてから決めたいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please first check the scheduled transfer's status and whether its date can be changed or it can be canceled. If that isn't possible, I'd like to hear the options, including fees, before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask for the scheduled status and possibilities for change or cancellation to be checked first, and say you want to hear options and costs if those are impossible before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。なお、学校が期限内の支払いとして認める条件は、銀行では決められません。学校側へも確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The bank can't decide the conditions under which the school accepts a payment as on time. Have you checked with the school too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 学校への確認はこれからです。銀行で分かった状態を伝えて、いつの入金が必要なのか尋ねます。それまでは追加の振込をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行の確認結果を学校へ伝えて必要な入金時点を尋ね、当面は追加振込をしないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't checked with the school yet. I'll tell them the status confirmed by the bank and ask when the funds need to arrive. Until then, I won't make an additional transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will tell the school the bank's findings, ask when the funds must arrive, and make no additional transfer for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人確認の案内から進めます。予約の照会が終わるまで操作は止め、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll begin with identification guidance. Stop operating the screen until the scheduled-transfer inquiry is finished, and wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計に進む前に、魚のパックで確かめたいことがあると伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you want to check something about the fish packs before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ棚の魚を二つ取りましたが、パックの金額が違います。棚には一つの値段しかなかったので、同じ金額だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ棚の魚二パックが同額と思っていたのに表示金額が違うと会計前に尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took two packs of fish from the same shelf, but their marked amounts differ. The shelf had only one price, so I thought they cost the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask before payment why two fish packs from the same shelf have different marked amounts when you thought they cost the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の表示は一パックの価格でしょうか、それとも重さ当たりでしょうか。ラベルを一緒に見てもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the shelf label a price per pack or per unit of weight? May we look at the labels together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりと書いてありますね。二つの重さが違うから金額も違うのか、ラベルで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚が百グラム当たりの表示と気づき、異なる重さが金額差の理由かラベルで確かめたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says per one hundred grams. I'd like to check the labels to see whether the different weights explain the different amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you noticed the shelf price is per one hundred grams and want to check the labels to see whether weight differences explain the price difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの重さと表示金額を照合します。二つを購入されるご予定でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare each weight and marked amount. Are you planning to buy both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予算を超えそうなので、小さいほうだけにしたいです。まだ支払っていませんが、大きいほうを会計から外せるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予算を超えそうなので小さいパックだけにし、未決済の大きいパックを外せるか確認を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It looks likely to exceed my budget, so I'd like only the smaller one. I haven't paid yet; please check whether the larger one can be removed from the bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, request only the smaller pack because of your budget, and ask whether the unpaid larger pack can be removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 登録内容を確認してから、変更後の合計をお示しします。袋はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking the registered items, we'll show you the revised total. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買い物袋はありますが、魚を入れる小袋が必要です。有料なら金額を聞いてから、付けるか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買い物袋はあるが魚用の小袋を希望し、有料なら価格を聞いて付けるか決めたいと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a shopping bag, but need a small bag for the fish. If it costs money, I want to hear the price before deciding whether to add it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, answer that you have a shopping bag but want a small fish bag, and if it costs money you want the price before deciding whether to add it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小袋の扱いも確認します。お支払いはどうなさいますか。いま画面に出ている数字は、ポイントの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check how the small bag is provided too. How would you like to pay? The number currently on the screen shows points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その数字を支払い残高だと思っていました。ポイントを使わず、このカードで払えるか確認し、小袋を含めた合計を見てから決済します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ポイント表示を残高と誤解したと述べ、ポイントを使わずカード利用可否と小袋込み合計を確認後に払うと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I thought that number was my payment balance. I won't use points; I'll check whether I can pay with this card and see the total including the small bag before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you mistook points for a balance, and will pay without points after checking card acceptance and the total including the small bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: カードの利用可否と袋の扱いを調べ、変更した明細をお見せします。まだ決済せず、こちらの表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check card acceptance and the bag, then show you the revised details. Don't pay yet; please check this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の前に、戻る場所を決めておきたいのですね。どなたかとお待ち合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to decide where to return before walking. Are you meeting someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が後で来るので、入口に戻りたいです。この一周コースなら、歩き終わった所が待合せの入口になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後から来る友人に入口で会いたく、一周の終点が待合せ入口になると思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is coming later, so I want to return to the entrance. I thought the end of this circuit would be the entrance where we're meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you want to meet a friend arriving later at the entrance and thought the circuit ended at that meeting entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図には入口が二か所あります。入っていらした時の看板や、近くの目印を覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map shows two entrances. Do you remember the sign where you entered or a nearby landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時計のある看板から入りました。指していた入口には時計の印がないので、別の場所かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時計の看板から入ったが指した入口には時計印がなく、別の入口かもしれないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered by the sign with a clock. The entrance I was pointing at has no clock symbol, so it may be a different place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you entered by a clock sign but the entrance you pointed to has no clock symbol and may be a different entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時計の印はこちらです。ご友人にも同じ入口と伝わっているか、届いた連絡で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The clock symbol is here. Can you check the messages you've received to see whether your friend understands the same entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人から入口の写真が届きました。時計が写っているので、こちらの印と同じか見比べてください。入口とだけ伝えていたので心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の写真の時計を案内図と照合してほしいと頼み、入口としか伝えていない不安を説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend sent a photo of the entrance. It shows a clock, so please compare it with this symbol. I'm worried because I only said ‘the entrance.’
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask for the clock in your friend's photo to be compared with the map, and explain your concern because you only said the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の目印はこの表示と一致しています。今度は散歩ですが、一周すると反対側の入口の近くも通ります。お待ち合わせまで余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The landmark in the photo matches this marker. About the walk: the circuit also passes near the opposite entrance. Do you have much time before meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あまり余裕がありません。一周はやめて、時計の入口へ戻る途中で休める短い道がないか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待合せまで余裕がなく一周をやめ、時計の入口へ戻る途中で休める短い道を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not much. I'll skip the circuit and would like to know a short route with somewhere to rest on the way back to the clock entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say there is little time before meeting, give up the circuit, and ask for a short route with a rest stop on the way back to the clock entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図で戻る道と休憩場所の表示を確認しましょう。所要時間は歩く速さや休憩で変わるので、時間が来たら途中で引き返すことも考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the return route and rest-area markers on the map. Time needed depends on your pace and breaks, so consider turning back partway when it's time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の時計を見てから出発し、時間に余裕を残して引き返します。友人にも時計の写真を送り、ほかの入口へ行かないよう待合せ場所をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口の時計を見て出発し余裕を残して引き返し、友人にも時計の写真を送り待合せ入口を一致させると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the entrance clock before setting off and turn back with time to spare. I'll send my friend a photo of the clock too so we agree on the meeting entrance and don't go to different ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will check the entrance clock before leaving, turn back with time to spare, and send your friend the clock photo to agree on the same meeting entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、図の現在地と時計の入口をもう一度指して確かめましょう。待合せに間に合う範囲で散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's point to the current location and clock entrance on the map once more to check. Enjoy a walk that leaves enough time for your meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再開見込みの表示をご覧ですね。お手元の切符の列車について確認なさりたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the expected service-resumption notice. Would you like to check the train on your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事先へ向かう列車が止まっています。「再開見込み」と出たので、もうホームで乗車を待ってよいのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事先への列車が停止中で、再開見込みの表示を見てホームで乗車待ちしてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The train I'm taking to work has stopped running. Now that it says ‘expected resumption,’ I'd like to know whether I can go to the platform and wait to board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that your train to work has stopped and ask whether the expected-resumption notice means you can wait to board on the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示と、個別の列車の乗車案内は分けて確認します。切符の列車名と、ご覧になった表示を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check that notice separately from boarding information for an individual train. Please show your ticket's train name and the notice you saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符です。画面には路線全体のことしか書かれていませんでした。自分の列車も乗れるという意味だと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符を示し、路線全体の表示を自分の列車に乗れる意味と取り違えたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the ticket. The screen only mentioned the entire line. I assumed that meant I could board my own train too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show your ticket and explain that you mistook a line-wide notice for permission to board your particular train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列車の案内はまだ確認が必要です。お仕事の予定について、先方とは連絡が取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Information for this train still needs checking. Have you been in touch with your workplace about your schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場から、移動が難しければ打ち合わせにオンラインで参加してよいと連絡が来ました。再開を待つ前に、行く必要があるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場からオンライン参加の提案が来たと伝え、再開を待つ前に移動の必要を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My workplace said I could join the meeting online if travel is difficult. Before waiting for resumption, I'll check whether I need to go there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say your workplace proposed online attendance and you will check the need to travel before waiting for service to resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認をなさっている間、切符の変更や払戻しの条件も照会できます。切符は、こちらの窓口でお求めになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: While you check, we can also inquire about ticket-change and refund conditions. Did you purchase the ticket at this counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社が別の予約サービスで手配したものです。ここですぐ返金できるとは思わず、手配した担当者にも変更の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社が別サービスで手配した切符と伝え、即返金と決めず手配担当へ変更を相談すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My company arranged it through a different reservation service. I won't assume it can be refunded here immediately, and will ask the person who arranged it about changes too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the company booked through another service, and say you will consult the arranger about changes without assuming an immediate refund here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入方法によって確認先が異なる場合があります。先方への連絡が済んでから、この列車の情報と切符の扱いを整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The appropriate contact may depend on the purchase method. After you've contacted them, let's organize the train information and how the ticket is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: オンライン参加でよいと返事が来ました。今日は無理に移動せず、切符を変更できるか会社へ確認します。再開見込みだけでホームへ向かわないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: オンライン参加を承諾されたため移動をやめ、切符変更を会社へ確認し再開見込みだけでホームへ向かわないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: They've replied that online attendance is fine. I won't force myself to travel today, and will ask the company whether the ticket can be changed. I won't head to the platform based only on expected resumption.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say online attendance was approved, so you will not travel, will check ticket changes with the company, and won't go to the platform based only on expected resumption.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 移動を取りやめるご意向ですね。切符の扱いが確定したわけではないので、会社の担当者と購入先への照会を続けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you intend to cancel your travel. The ticket arrangements are not settled, so please continue checking with your company's contact and the seller.
